entries.note: Resolve paths using their stored root and real paths, including symlink targets. Roots identify distinct worktrees; a focused tree never supplies an implicit file root. entries.note: Serialize saves per canonical file, check the disk hash before and after staging, and retain the draft on conflicts. Rename preserves a whole file version. This is not an OS-level compare-and-swap against arbitrary external writers; power-loss durability and draft checkpoint scheduling still require qualification.

The canonical declaration filename is durable metadata on the real project root, not a substitute root. Omitted declarations preserve an existing binding; a conflicting explicit filename is refused. The original host owns this state, so a worker update alone cannot add support to a legacy host. Registration checks file existence and type; later read errors belong to the declaration reader. No project-local configuration is written.

This exists because spec 096 shipped without it and was shaped for the wrong event. Session records live in the host's memory (Sessions keeps a Map), so a conversation recorded there dies with the host — and a host restart is precisely what a person reaches for a resume after. Persisting here, beside roots and drafts, is what makes resuming mean anything across the only event that matters. The bound is not decoration: this file is rewritten whole on every persist, so an unbounded per-root list would grow the write. Re-recording touches and re-fronts an existing row rather than appending, so a conversation resumed daily stays one row. See docs/specs/097-agent-conversation-persistence.md.
